Elizabeth is an NPC located in the  Community Center. To access her associated features, players must be at least SkyBlock Level 3 .

Usage

[edit | edit source]
Main articles: City Projects, Fire Sales, Account & Profile Upgrades, Booster Cookie, and Bits

Elizabeth has many different features in her menu, such as the option to see the most recent and all past City Projects and Fire Sales.

Another feature is the Account & Profile Upgrades menu, where players can get bonuses for them on all of their profiles, such as more  Magic Find and Ender Chest pages. The player can also get bonuses for all their co-op members on one profile, some for free (like Minion Slots, some costing SkyBlock Gems such as Co-op slots.

Another menu allows players to receive  1 Booster Cookie for free and then purchase additional ones for SkyBlock Gems. The user can buy  1 Booster Cookie for 325 SkyBlock Gems,  6 Booster Cookies for 1,950 SkyBlock Gems, or  12 Booster Cookies for 3,900 SkyBlock Gems.

In her menu is also located the Bits Shop, where players can use Bits, obtained using  Booster Cookies, to purchase various items. Most notably, the player can buy a  God Potion for 1,500 Bits, a  Kismet Feather for 1,350 Bits,  Pure Black Dye and  Pure White Dye for 250,000 Bits, and Enrichments for 5,000 Bits

Her last menu lists the 5 commonly available Ranks on Hypixel and their perks: 2[VIP], 3[VIP+], 4[MVP], 5[MVP+], and 6[MVP++]. Furthermore, there is an item at the bottom of this page, as well as other pages, displaying your current SkyBlock Gems, Bits, and Fame Rank.

After completing Brigette's account security quest, she gives the player a free  Booster Cookie.

Account and Profile Upgrades

[edit | edit source]
This article needs to be reworked as its content is outdated.

You can help the wiki by editing this page and reworking it.

Reason: 2026/April 8 Changes to Skyblock Gem bundles resulting in an increase of cost
This article was last edited by Pigicial (contribs|logs|block) on 1:25, September 3 2026 (50 days ago)

These upgrades can be applied to either your current profile or your entire account. Some upgrades are free, while others require SkyBlock Gems to unlock. Each upgrade takes a certain amount of time to complete, but you can use SkyBlock Gems to skip the waiting.

To fully upgrade everything to the maximum level, a player will need 6,050 SkyBlock Gems. The total waiting time is 382 real-world days for profile upgrades and 244 days for account upgrades. You can choose to spend an additional 80,904 SkyBlock Gems to skip the waiting period entirely. The cost will depend on the current value of SkyBlock Gems.

The best option is to buy 3 × 1,800 packs + 1 × 700 pack for a total of 6,100 Gems at a cost of $61,67 — but only if you plan to upgrade without skipping the waiting time.

The best option, considering you need the previous gems to upgrade and skip the waiting time, is to buy: 4 × 17,000 packs + 1 × 7,600 pack + 1 × 3,750 pack + 1 × 1,800 pack for a total of 6,300 Gems at a cost of $707.78.

Trivia

[edit | edit source]
  • The patch notes for the Better Mayors update claim that "Elizabeth was too stubborn to move, so she is staying at the same location". Despite this claim, she actually moved 4 blocks.
  • On the Alpha Hypixel Network, the Community Shop requires SkyBlock Level 10 instead of SkyBlock Level 3 .
  • When Elizabeth says "That's rough, buddy." during the Security Safety Quest; it appears to be a reference to Prince Zuko from ATLA.
